name: Pane
author: E. T. Carter
description: Rain on a dusk window: beyond the glass an out-of-focus city of peach and slate seven-sided bokeh, a dark skyline and a spire with a blinking light under indigo cloud; on the glass, beads each hold a small refracted image of the lights while runnels slide down meandering clear trails through the condensation, framed by a painted mullion on the right third and a transom with beaded top edge.

params.label: Rain
params.effect: How many beads cling to the glass and how fast the runnels slide.

params.label: Defocus
params.effect: How far out of focus the city beyond the glass sits, from crisp points and lit windows to wide aperture discs.

params.label: City glow
params.effect: Brightness of the windows, lamps and car lights.
